title: QuickNode Streams filter: XRPL transactions touching Titan Ghost maker / router accounts
status: READY_TO_DEPLOY — NOT DEPLOYED. No stream has been created. Creating one is a separate, operator-approved step in the QuickNode dashboard or Streams REST API.
network: XRP Ledger Testnet (the demo maker/router accounts live on Testnet; use Mainnet only for Titan Ghost's own public Mainnet addresses)

addresses.source: GET /api/status at runtime -> accounts.<role>.address (public r-addresses only; seeds never leave the server)
addresses.render: renderStreamFilter(statusJson) in lib/vendors/quicknode.mjs, or GET /api/vendors/quicknode/stream-filter on a running node

destination.note: Point at an authenticated HTTPS receiver. This node listens on 127.0.0.1 and exposes no webhook route today, so nothing would receive it yet.

safety: Read-only: a Stream only delivers ledger data. It cannot sign, submit or move funds.
Addresses are public r-addresses read from GET /api/status. No seeds, keys or tokens are in this template.
The input shape (stream.data[].transactions[] with tx_json/meta) should be confirmed with the dashboard's 'Test filter' against a real Testnet ledger before enabling.
